CustomField.label: Test Mode
CustomField.description: When true, OCC_SendVerificationCode does not email the code and stores it in plain text on the verification row, so the harness - and the demo - can read it there. This is a Developer Edition trade-off, not a design choice: the org sends without domain authentication (Proton flags it as phishing) and allows only 15 single emails a day. In production this stays false and the code only ever exists in the caller's mailbox.
